titleZh: 单元复习:我的第一个学期
goalZh: 读懂并会讲一段回顾几个月经历的短文,综合复习一般过去时和整个 A1 的话题
canDoZh: 能用一段话讲讲自己过去几个月的经历和变化:刚来时怎样、做了什么、现在怎样、接下来打算做什么

newItems.noteZh: 美国大学多数一年两个学期(秋季、春季);重音在中间 se-MES-ter;下学期 next semester。
ner 卷舌,v 上齿碰下唇;I was nervous. 我当时很紧张。
learn 强调学会、学到(I learned a lot.),study 强调学习的过程;学游泳 learn to swim。
重音在前 CON-fi-dent;I'm confident now. 我现在很自信。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: When I came to Seattle, I was really nervous.
lines.zh: 我刚来西雅图的时候,特别紧张。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I didn't understand people, and I was very shy.
lines.zh: 我听不懂别人说话,而且很害羞。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Then I made friends: Amy, Ethan, Sofia, and Marcus.
lines.zh: 后来我交到了朋友:艾米、伊森、索菲亚和马库斯。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I started a part-time job at a cafe.
lines.zh: 我在一家咖啡馆做起了兼职。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I learned a lot there. Now I can talk to customers!
lines.zh: 我在那儿学到了很多。现在我能和顾客聊天了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I can also take the bus downtown and buy clothes.
lines.zh: 我还会坐公交去市中心,自己买衣服。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: After our hiking trip, I was sick, but I got better.
lines.zh: 那次徒步回来,我病了一场,不过后来好了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I had my first Halloween and my first Thanksgiving.
lines.zh: 我过了第一个万圣节和第一个感恩节。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Thanksgiving was two weeks ago. I'm thankful for my friends here.
lines.zh: 感恩节是两周前。我很感谢这里的朋友们。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Now I'm not nervous. I'm confident, and I talk a lot!
lines.zh: 现在我不紧张了。我很自信,话也多了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Next semester, I'm going to learn to swim with Ethan.
lines.zh: 下学期,我打算跟伊森学游泳。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But first, I'm going to go home to Chengdu. I miss my family!
lines.zh: 不过在那之前,我要先回成都。我想家了!

grammar.titleZh: 过去、现在、将来:三种时间一起用
grammar.bodyZh: 讲自己的变化,要把三种时间分清楚:过去的事用一般过去时(I was nervous. I made friends.);现在的情况和习惯用一般现在时(Now I'm confident. I work at a cafe.);打算好的将来用 be going to(Next semester, I'm going to learn to swim.)。用 When I came here, I was… 开头,能自然地从过去讲起;再用 Now… 转到现在,用 Next semester… 讲打算。时间词就是信号:ago、last、yesterday、when I came here 配过去式;now、every day 配一般现在时;next、tomorrow、this weekend 配 be going to。

examples.text: When I came to Seattle, I was really nervous.
examples.zh: 我刚来西雅图的时候特别紧张。

examples.text: Now I'm confident, and I talk a lot.
examples.zh: 现在我很自信,话也多了。

examples.text: I work at a cafe two afternoons a week.
examples.zh: 我每周在咖啡馆上两个下午的班。

examples.text: Next semester, I'm going to learn to swim.

grammar.titleZh: 复习:过去式怎么变、怎么读
grammar.bodyZh: 第 8 单元学的过去式:be 动词用 was / were;规则动词加 -ed,读 /t/(talked、finished)、/d/(learned、cleaned)或 /ɪd/(started、visited);常用不规则动词要单独记:came、made、had、saw、got、went、ate、bought。问句和否定用 did / didn't + 动词原形:Did you understand? —— No, I didn't.。朗读这篇短文时,-ed 词尾一定要读出来;句子重音放在关键的词上(nervous、confident、first);逗号、句号处稍微停一下,听起来更从容。

examples.text: I learned a lot at the cafe.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡馆学到了很多。(learned 读 /d/)

examples.text: I made friends, and I had my first Thanksgiving.
examples.zh: 我交到了朋友,还过了第一个感恩节。

examples.text: Did you understand? — No, I didn't.
